# uptimepage_monitor_group (Resource)

A monitor group. Monitors join it with `group_id` on uptimepage_target. By default a group is a label; with alert_as_one it pages as a single thing: the first member failure opens one group incident, later failures join it, and the members' own channels stay quiet. Deleting it keeps its monitors, ungrouped.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptimepage_notification_channel" "ops" {
  name = "ops slack"
  config = {
    type  = "slack"
    slack = { webhook_url = var.slack_webhook_url }
  }
}

# One incident and one page for every DNS record of the domain: the first
# record down opens the group incident, later ones join it.
resource "uptimepage_monitor_group" "dns" {
  name                   = "example.com DNS"
  alert_as_one           = true
  alerts                 = [{ channel_id = uptimepage_notification_channel.ops.id }]
  renotify_interval_secs = 1800
  alert_again            = true
  tags                   = ["dns", "p0"]
}

resource "uptimepage_target" "ns" {
  name     = "example.com NS"
  interval = 300
  group_id = uptimepage_monitor_group.dns.id
  check = {
    type = "dns"
    dns = {
      domain      = "example.com"
      record_type = "NS"
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Group name, unique in the organization, at most 50 characters after trimming.

### Optional

- `alert_again` (Boolean) Whether a member that goes down while the group incident is open sends a message. Messages are coalesced to at most one a minute, naming every member down since the last one. Off, a later failure only adds a line to the incident's timeline. An acknowledgement stays either way.
- `alert_as_one` (Boolean) Whether the group pages as one. On, a member's failure opens or joins the group incident, which pages this group's alerts and reminder; the members' own alerts, reminder and escalation policy stay quiet, and the group's tags stand in for theirs where channel tag rules match. Off, each monitor alerts on its own. A switch changes only failures that start after it: an incident open at the time ends the way it started.
- `alerts` (Attributes List) Notification channels the group incident pages while the group alerts as one. They also receive its monitoring-stopped notices. While an escalation policy applies to the group (bound in the app or over the API, or the organization default), the policy pages its levels instead. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--alerts))
- `renotify_interval_secs` (Number) Seconds before the first reminder while the group incident stays unacknowledged; each further reminder waits twice as long, up to a day. 0 turns reminders off; otherwise at least 60.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags the members carry while the group alerts as one, in place of their own, for channel tag rules and the tag filter. A member's own `tags` attribute keeps its own tags, so it shows no drift.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Group id (UUID).

### Nested Schema for `alerts`

Required:

- `channel_id` (String) Notification channel id (lowercase UUID).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an existing group by its UUID, the last part of its settings page
# URL. A group made by a monitor's group_name or in the app already exists, so
# import it rather than declaring it fresh.
terraform import uptimepage_monitor_group.dns 0192f3a4-5b6c-7d8e-9f01-23456789abcd
```
